exclusions.reason: The outer equality loads end/capacity together. At the inner comparison both differences use the same unchanged begin and equal end/capacity, so unsigned BHS always branches to growth.

R4 preserves the old end; after copying prefix and new entry, LDRD reloads the same begin/end. Under a provider that does not mutate caller vector fields, CMP R4,oldEnd is equal and the suffix loop is skipped.
The unsigned BLS skips the empty pointer-destruction loop whenever begin<=end, including the null empty vector. The qualified domain requires a single valid allocation with begin<=end<=capacity.

limits: Static exclusion is specific to well-formed live vectors and allocator providers that do not mutate caller fields.
Allocator failure/invalid pointer triples/overflow remain outside this proof; no universal reachability or whole-game claim.
